description: Trunk-ref correctness not pinned as a testable requirement and not fail-closed. Predicate 3 uses an abstract <trunk>, but the fixture/E2E hardcode --trunk=main while .openclaw trunk is main-internal. A wrong/defaulted/missing trunk makes `rev-list trunk..branch` compute against the wrong base; a wrong trunk that contains the work makes unmerged work look merged -> false-negative -> deletion. No REQ specifies per-repo trunk resolution or fail-closed behavior on unresolved trunk.
fix: Add REQ: resolve trunk per-repo (anicca/anicca-project=main, .openclaw=main-internal, monk-factory=main); if trunk cannot be resolved or rev-list errors, classify ACTIVE (fail-closed). Add a PROP asserting wrong/missing trunk -> ACTIVE.
